people.name: Cean Nicholas Kenefick-rogers
people.bio_note: Cean Kenefick-Rogers has 20+ years in financial services. He co-founded Ironwood Wealth Management (Chandler, AZ) roughly two decades ago, starting his career in the insurance and brokerage worlds before he and his partners transitioned the firm to an independent RIA, ultimately dropping their FINRA licenses on legal advice. He served as Ironwood's CEO for the firm's last six years, during which he led it to just under $550M AUM across nearly 500 households. In an early growth phase, he and his partners hit a compensation/accountability standoff across their differing books of business and brought in an outside industry consultant to restructure partner roles and pay — a turnaround he later discussed publicly as a notable case study in RIA partnership management, featured as a full episode (Ep. 306, Nov 2022) of Michael Kitces' industry-leading 'Financial Advisor Success' podcast. In May 2025 he left Ironwood to found WLTH Capital Management, LLC in Chandler, AZ, where he is Founder, CEO, and Managing Partner, focused on high-net-worth households and philanthropists with $5M+ in investable assets. The firm's launch and subsequent expansion (adding the CPWA credential in September 2025) were both covered in PRWeb press releases. He holds the CFA, CFP, CPWA, and AIF designations. His stated philosophy emphasizes trust-based client relationships and aligning wealth strategy with clients' personal values and philanthropic goals.

firm_note.text: WLTH Capital Management is an independent, SEC-registered, fee-only RIA in Chandler, AZ that officially launched May 7, 2025, founded by Cean Kenefick-Rogers (former Co-Founder/CEO of Ironwood Wealth Management). Firm targets high-net-worth individuals, business owners, and philanthropists with $5M+ investable assets, offering financial planning, portfolio management, tax planning, and charitable giving strategies (motto: "Integrity. Trust. Prosperity."). Announced via two PRWeb press releases: firm launch (May 2025) and, in September 2025, expansion into advanced philanthropic planning after the firm secured the CPWA credential. AUM ~$229.8M across 83 clients per web search.
